name: Disneyland Alien Pizza Planet "Count Down Chicken Fusilli" (Pesto Cream Pasta)
whyItWorks: Spiral fusilli pasta tossed with tender grilled chicken breast, parmesan-pesto cream sauce, and sun-dried tomatoes. Pasta and chicken provide easily chewed, comforting energy.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Count Down Chicken Fusilli; ask for light sauce.
watchOuts: Pesto cream sauce contains dairy and finely pureed herbs
